cards.title: Derive card authors from provenance, not chair input
cards.body: Self-vote exclusion in tally() trusts each card's authors list, and the chair types that list by hand twice: in pool.json at merge and in candidates.json at fuse. _check_cards only checks that authors is a non-empty list of expert seat ids; nothing reads the from or parents fields. A fused card built from L2 and L3 cards but labelled [L1] lets L2 and L3 rank their own work, unrecorded. Fix: ingest_merge requires every from ref to be a real kept-card ref and sets authors to those seats; ingest_fuse requires parents to be shortlisted pool ids and sets authors to the union of the parents' authors. One unit test covers both.
cards.evidence: skills/council-loop/scripts/run.py: _check_cards (lines 974-983), ingest_merge, ingest_fuse (line 1084 copies parents unchecked); council.py tally() own-label exclusion (line 349). Read on paper; no exploit test run.
cards.eli5: The computer, not the referee, writes whose idea each card came from, so nobody can vote for their own.

cards.title: Give each voter its own candidate order
cards.body: blind() is seeded only by run, loop and phase, so every voter in a phase gets the identical packet, and the same card sits first on all seven ballots. LLM judges show measurable position bias (Zheng et al. 2023, MT-Bench), so a shared order adds the same tilt to every ballot and Borda sums it instead of cancelling it. Fix: keep one label-to-card mapping per phase, but have write_seat_prompts render each seat's copy in a rotated order (Latin square over seats), so each card leads about equally often. Labels, mapping and tally are unchanged; no model calls. Test: with seats at least equal to cards, every label leads some packet.
cards.evidence: skills/council-loop/scripts/run.py seed_for() and _vote_prompts() write one packet for all seats; council.py blind() emits cards in label order. Position bias: Zheng et al. 2023 'Judging LLM-as-a-Judge' (from memory, not re-checked this session).
cards.eli5: Everyone sees the cards in a different order, so being listed first stops giving a free boost.
